title: Sling: before start, start, and warm-up
briefing: Cold and dark on the ramp. Work the before-start list, start the Rotax 912 iS as the POH supplement describes (EMS back-up on, lane lights, both fuel pumps, starter no longer than 10 seconds, oil pressure within 10 seconds), then warm up: 2,000 rpm for two minutes, then 2,500 rpm until the oil reaches 50 C. Use Show me on any item. This is simulated training from the POH; the real POH governs.
